description: This file defines a UI component named 'EmptyState' using LightningJS. It imports external styling and UI building modules and supplies a template with computed style properties.

classes.name: EmptyState
classes.description: A LightningJS component that displays an empty state message with styled background and foreground elements.

methods.name: surfaceColor
methods.description: Returns the surface color from the theme.

methods.name: primaryColor
methods.description: Returns the primary color from the theme.

methods.name: textColor
methods.description: Returns the text color from the theme.

methods.name: radiusLg
methods.description: Returns large radius value from the theme radii.

methods.name: radiusLgOutline
methods.description: Returns the outline radius, which is the large radius plus 2.

methods.name: msg
methods.description: Computes the message to display, defaulting to 'No recipes found. Try a different search.'
